data.narrative:
Solinftec is a Series B-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $40M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 9 private and 1 public company in the Robotics & Manufacturing sector, including same-stage peers Generalist AI ($2.0B), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B), and Dexterity ($1.6B), alongside later-stage references including Divergent and Exotec.

Two valuation methods were applied. The Stage-Progression method, anchored to the $40M total raised as a proxy for current implied valuation, applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical for Series B advancement, yielding $76M. The Peer-Median method uses the median valuation of the three same-sector, same-stage comparables at $1.8B, with a range of $1.6B to $2.0B. These methods produce meaningfully divergent results, reflecting uncertainty around whether Solinftec's development profile and market position align more closely with the earlier-stage cost basis or with mature Series B robotics companies commanding substantially higher valuations.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $65M (floor, stage-progression low) to $2.0B (ceiling, peer maximum), with a median of $913M. Given the wide dispersion and limited visibility into Solinftec's revenue, unit economics, and competitive positioning relative to named peers, the peer-median method should be weighted cautiously. Key uncertainties include the applicability of the $1.6B–$2.0B peer set to Solinftec's specific technology and market maturity.
